financings_after_balance_sheet.what: ATM sales of common stock, April 1 to May 14, 2024
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: From April 1, 2024 to May 14, 2024, the Company issued an aggregate of 19,863,548 shares of common stock under the December 2021 ATM Agreement for total net proceeds of $2.2 million.

warrants.quote: the Company issued (i) Iliad warrants to purchase up to 1,711,954 shares of the common stock and (ii) Uptown warrants to purchase up to 2,105,348 shares of the common stock
warrants to purchase up to 232,500 shares of the Company’s common stock at an exercise price of $0.37 per share.
